parameters.subject: =🏁 {{ $('Build Unified Payload').item.json.race.name }} {{ $('Build Unified Payload').item.json.race.season }} — Race Report

parameters.jsCode:
const a = $('Parse AI Outputs').item.json.analysis;
const c = $('Parse AI Outputs').item.json.championship;
const r = $('Build Unified Payload').item.json.race;
const s = $('Build Unified Payload').item.json.season;
return [{ json: {
  race_name:            a.race_name,
  race_circuit:         a.race_circuit,
  race_country:         a.race_country,
  race_date:            a.race_date,
  season:               r.season,
  round:                r.round,
  winner:               a.podium?.[0]?.driver,
  winner_team:          a.podium?.[0]?.constructor,
  p2_driver:            a.podium?.[1]?.driver,
  p3_driver:            a.podium?.[2]?.driver,
  podium_json:          JSON.stringify(a.podium),
  fastest_lap_driver:   a.fastest_lap?.driver,
  fastest_lap_time:     a.fastest_lap?.lap_time,
  biggest_mover:        a.biggest_mover?.driver,
  biggest_mover_gained: a.biggest_mover?.gained,
  strategy_winner:      a.strategy_winner,
  notable_dnfs:         a.notable_dnfs,
  race_rating:          a.race_rating,
  race_verdict:         a.race_verdict,
  wdc_leader:           c.wdc_leader,
  wdc_gap:              c.wdc_gap,
  championship_verdict: c.championship_verdict,
  is_title_over:        c.is_title_over,
  races_remaining:      s.racesLeft,
  points_available:     s.pointsLeft,
  raw_analysis_json:    JSON.stringify(a),
  raw_championship_json:JSON.stringify(c),
  created_at:           new Date().toISOString()
}}];

parameters.body: {   "model": "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",   "max_tokens": 200,   "messages": [     {       "role": "user",       "content": "Give me one short, surprising and interesting F1 fact. Keep it under 3 sentences. No hashtags. No markdown. Plain text only."     }   ] }
